label: Volcano Near Small Ledge
literalRoomDescription: You are about two hundred feet above the volcano floor. Looming above is the rim of the volcano. There is a small ledge on the west side.
safeSceneProfile: Volcano airborne band 2. No standing floor: player support comes from the source balloon, not invisible platforms. Preserve source-described elevation and ledge visibility without adding landings; only band 4 explicitly opens to sky.

label: Narrow Ledge
literalRoomDescription: You are on a narrow ledge within an old dormant volcano. This ledge is about halfway between the floor below and the rim above. There is an exit to the south.
safeSceneProfile: Narrow ledge halfway up dormant volcano with southern exit and separate hook. No walkable floor across the volcanic void.

guardedRoomSource.sourceText:
<ROUTINE LEDGE-FCN (RARG)
    <COND (<EQUAL? .RARG ,M-LOOK>
	   <TELL
"You are on a wide ledge high in the volcano. The rim of the volcano is
about 200 feet above and there is a precipitous drop to the bottom.">
	   <COND (<FSET? ,SAFE-ROOM ,RMUNGBIT>
		  <TELL " The way to the south is blocked by rubble." CR>)
		 (T <TELL " There is a small door to the south." CR>)>)>>

label: End of Ledge
literalRoomDescription: A ledge from the east ends here, and a tunnel leads north into the wall. There is a rather odd smokey odor in the warm air of the tunnel.
safeSceneProfile: Eastern ledge ends at warm smoky north tunnel into the rock; no invented fresh-air skylight.

view.message: There are a lot of sharp rocks down there.

label: Volcano View
literalRoomDescription: You are on a ledge in the middle of a large volcano. Below you the volcano bottom can be seen and above is the rim of the volcano. A couple of ledges can be seen on the other side of the volcano; it appears that this ledge is intermediate in elevation between those on the other side. The exit from this room is to the east.
safeSceneProfile: Intermediate viewing ledge in large volcano with east exit; distant ledges are visual background only, not new traversal routes or visible treasures.

view.message: It is impossible to cross this distance.
